steps.what: Communicate client assessment findings and recommendations and clarify their meaning with recipients

tasks.design: Retain recipient-specific explanation and clarification with the therapist, using accepted material in {DOCS}. Separate clinical report composition is counted in the report-writing task, so its saving is not repeated here.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recipients need context and may misunderstand the limits of findings.
tasks.enabler_now: No additional reduction in clinical communication is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining uncertainty and confirming appropriate disclosure.

reach.learn: How different recipients interpret clinical caveats

evidence.claim: A report-drafting saving must not be counted again as reduced communication of the same findings.

assumptions: Boundary is recipient-specific communication, including checking content and disclosure, rather than separate report composition. Written, audio or video delivery keeps its current time.
Findings are produced by completed assessment work; the therapist checks recipient and permitted scope during fully counted communication, with no free disclosure-authorised flag.
Use existing records and communication channels.
Unchanged communication has no incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Which findings most often need additional explanation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross=net=0%. Separate report-writing savings are not counted twice.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Adapt therapy programs for specific populations

steps.what: Customize art therapy programs for client populations and their actual care settings

tasks.design: Retain population-specific program adaptation with the art therapist using existing {DOCS} resources. A general activity description does not establish that a program suits a school, hospital or other setting.
tasks.previous_blocker: Different settings have distinct needs, restrictions and therapeutic relationships.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported replacement of adaptation judgement is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Matching activities, materials and facilitation to real circumstances.
tasks.human_edge: Clinical understanding and collaboration with the setting.
tasks.altitude: Program adaptation remains clinical design work

reach.learn: How accessibility and practical limitations affect participation

evidence.claim: Draft activity text does not establish clinical suitability for a specific population or setting.

assumptions: Scope is substantive population adaptation, distinct from individual session design and report formatting.
The therapist elicits setting constraints and population needs in fully counted work; no free suitable-activity flag.
Use existing clinical and activity resources.
No changed design process means zero upkeep.
research_questions: Which setting restrictions most often change the therapeutic design?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0%; substantive adaptation retains full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Confer with professionals to develop, coordinate and integrate the client's treatment plans

tasks.design: Retain clinical discussion and integration with the therapist and care team. {DOCS} can provide current plans without replacing deliberation or duplicating separate report-writing savings.
tasks.previous_blocker: Integration requires understanding differing observations and responsibilities.
tasks.enabler_now: No shortening of clinical discussion is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving conflicting priorities and gaps in shared understanding.
tasks.human_edge: Professional dialogue and joint clinical reasoning.

reach.learn: How art therapy contributes to the broader plan

evidence.claim: Team deliberation has no established separate removable administrative baseline in this task.

assumptions: Scope is treatment-team discussion, not scheduling or separate plan documentation.
Other professionals supply their observations during actual care and discussion; no free agreed-plan flag.
research_questions: Which information gaps most often prevent integrated planning?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross=net=0%. Clinical discussion retains all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend or purchase therapy art supplies

steps.what: Recommend or purchase needed art supplies after checking client suitability and practical requirements

tasks.design: Retain supply suitability and purchase decisions with the therapist. {PROCUREMENT} may hold orders, but a recurring clerical burden is not established for this infrequent task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Materials must fit actual therapeutic needs and setting restrictions.
tasks.enabler_now: No task-specific reduction is established by generic ordering tools.
tasks.still_hard: Checking suitability, availability and practical constraints.
tasks.human_edge: Knowledge of clients and how materials are used.

evidence.claim: An infrequent suitability-led supply task does not establish a repeat ordering baseline worth automating.

assumptions: Selection, recommendation and any purchase time remain counted; no invented invoice administration.
The therapist checks actual needs, stock and restrictions during counted work; no free reorder level or safe-material flag.
unknowns: Current materials, restrictions and ordering process
research_questions: Is there repeated order preparation beyond suitability decisions?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=net=0%; no repeat clerical baseline is evidenced for this infrequent task.
